description: This file defines the IPasswordHasher interface in the Conduit.Infrastructure.Security namespace, which includes a method for hashing passwords asynchronously.

classes.name: IPasswordHasher
classes.description: An interface for password hashing implementations, including an asynchronous hash method and IDisposable inheritance.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Asynchronously hashes a password using a provided salt, returning the resulting hash as a byte array.
